qs.q: During Step 3 of community diagnosis data collection, a researcher conducts a Focus Group Discussion (FGD). What is a defining structural characteristic of an FGD according to the study notes?
o: It collects strictly quantitative data using numerical scores
It involves heterogeneous groups to maximize debate
It consists of homogeneous groups with a maximum of 15 members
It requires a fixed minimum of 30 sessions per community
qs.e: Focus Group Discussions are qualitative methods that use homogeneous groups with a maximum of 15 people per group. The total number of groups is determined by data saturation.
